atom: Implement PTY spawn with forkpty() for Ghostty
atom_description: Use Darwin forkpty() to spawn shell process in PTY, connect master FD to Ghostty terminal for input/output, and manage process lifecycle.
problem_statement: Ghostty terminal needs a PTY process to execute shell commands. Unlike SwiftTerm which has built-in PTY handling, Ghostty requires manual PTY spawning using POSIX forkpty() and FD management. This atom provides the process foundation.
scope_in: Call forkpty() to create PTY and spawn shell
Store PTY master FD in GhosttyBackend
Configure terminal size via winsize struct
Set environment variables for child process

constraints: Must use POSIX forkpty() not custom fork+pty logic
Must set TERM environment variable correctly
Must handle file descriptor ownership
Must not leak FDs on error paths
functional_requirements: Call forkpty() with shell path and env vars
Receive PTY master FD and child PID
Configure winsize struct with cols/rows from TerminalSize
Parent process stores master FD for read/write
Child process execs shell with correct environment
Return running state with PID after successful spawn
nonfunctional_requirements: No FD leaks on error or termination
Process isolation via PTY session leader
implementation_steps: Import Darwin for forkpty and winsize
Create winsize struct from TerminalSize
Prepare environment array as C strings
Call forkpty(&masterFD, nil, nil, &winsize)
In child process: exec shell with env
In parent process: store masterFD and pid
Set _state to .running(pid: pid)
Yield state change to stateContinuation
Start readOutput() task to read from masterFD
